candidate_plan: SEARCH ideas USING INDEX idx_status_config_hash_nocase (status=? AND config_hash=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
candidate_query:
SELECT idea_id, config FROM (
SELECT rowid AS position, idea_id, CASE WHEN typeof(config)='text' AND length(CAST(config AS BLOB)) <= ? THEN config ELSE NULL END AS config
FROM ideas WHERE status COLLATE NOCASE IN (?, ?, ?, ?) AND ((? = 'native_cpu_action' AND kind = 'native_cpu_action') OR (? != 'native_cpu_action' AND kind != 'native_cpu_action')) AND config_hash=?
UNION ALL
SELECT rowid AS position, idea_id, CASE WHEN typeof(config)='text' AND length(CAST(config AS BLOB)) <= ? THEN config ELSE NULL END AS config
FROM ideas WHERE status COLLATE NOCASE IN (?, ?, ?, ?) AND ((? = 'native_cpu_action' AND kind = 'native_cpu_action') OR (? != 'native_cpu_action' AND kind != 'native_cpu_action')) AND (config_hash IS NULL OR config_source_sha256 IS NULL) AND (config_hash IS NULL OR config_hash != ?)
) ORDER BY position LIMIT ?
limits: Read-only exploratory SQL probe on one synthetic 5000-history database. No product query changed.
No claim of admission equivalence: concurrent mutations, malformed indexes/catalogs, capacity, status/kind and null cases require a separate implementation slice.
No parser, source/lock/ACK/transaction/qualification time; this is not a complete ingress measurement.
